# PRODUCTION RUNTIME CANARY — DO NOT "FIX" THIS FILE.
#
# This is a verbatim reconstruction of the construct that took Vindex AI
# production down on 2026-08-08 (incident PROD-SYNTAX-001).
#
# It is stored as .txt, NOT .py, so that:
#   * `compileall` over the repo does not try to compile it, and
#   * the repo-wide AST scanner in tests/test_python311_production_compat.py
#     does not flag it (it globs *.py).
#
# The CI job `compile-on-production-python` copies it to a temporary .py and
# REQUIRES `python -m py_compile` to FAIL with a message mentioning
# "backslash", on the real python:3.11-slim interpreter.
#
# Expected behaviour:
#   Python 3.11  -> SyntaxError: f-string expression part cannot include a backslash
#   Python 3.12+ -> compiles fine (PEP 701 lifted the restriction)
#
# That asymmetry is the whole point: it is exactly why local Python 3.13 and a
# 3.13 CI both reported green while production could not import the module.
#
# If this file ever compiles on the CI interpreter, the gate has stopped
# protecting the thing it was built for and CI fails loudly rather than
# passing quietly.

case_context_blok = "kontekst"

prompt = f"""Si iskusni parnicar.

TEMA: nesto
{("\n" + case_context_blok + "\nAko je gornji blok dat, iskoristi ga.\n") if case_context_blok else ""}
Generisi listu pitanja.
"""
